H4100.def: or mah {mah}; or ma {maw}; or ma {mah}; also meh {meh}; a primitive particle; properly, interrogative what? (including how? why? when?); but also exclamation, what! (including how!), or indefinitely what (including whatever, and even relatively, that which); often used with prefixes in various adverbial or conjunctive senses:--how (long, oft, (- soever)), (no-)thing, what (end, good, purpose, thing), whereby(-fore, -in, -to, -with), (for) why.

H4101.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «04100»:--how great (mighty), that which, what(-soever), why.

H4102.def: apparently a denominative from «04100»; properly, to question or hesitate, i.e. (by implication) to be reluctant:--delay, linger, stay selves, tarry.

H4103.def: from «01949»; confusion or uproar:--destruction, discomfiture, trouble, tumult, vexation, vexed.

H4104.def: of Persian origin; Mehuman, a eunuch of Xerxes:--Mehuman.

H4105.def: from «03190» (augmented) and «0410»; bettered of God; Mehetabel, the name of an Edomitish man and woman:--Mehetabeel, Mehetabel.

H4106.def: or mahir {maw-here'}; from «04116»; quick; hence, skilful:--diligent, hasty, ready.

H4107.def: a primitive root; properly, to cut down or reduce, i.e. by implication, to adulterate:--mixed.

H4108.def: from «01980»; a walking (plural collectively), i.e. access:--place to walk.

H4109.def: from «01980»; a walk, i.e. a passage or a distance:--journey, walk.

H4111.def: from «04110» and «0410»; praise of God; Mahalalel, the name of an antediluvian patriarch and of an Israelite:--Mahalaleel.

H4113.et: from an unused root of uncertain meaning
H4113.def: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; perhaps an abyss:--deep pit.

H4115.def: from «02015»; a wrench, i.e. the stocks:--prison, stocks.

H4116.def: a primitive root; properly, to be liquid or flow easily, i.e. (by implication); to hurry (in a good or a bad sense); often used (with another verb) adverbially, promptly:--be carried headlong, fearful, (cause to make, in, make) haste(-n, -ily), (be) hasty, (fetch, make ready) × quickly, rash, × shortly, (be so) × soon, make speed, × speedily, × straightway, × suddenly, swift.

H4117.et: a primitive root (perhaps rather the same as (4116) through the idea of readiness in assent)
H4117.def: a primitive root (perhaps rather the same as «04116» through the idea of readiness in assent); to bargain (for a wife), i.e. to wed:--endow, × surely.

H4118.def: from «04116»; properly, hurrying; hence (adverbially) in a hurry:--hasteth, hastily, at once, quickly, soon, speedily, suddenly.

H4120.def: feminine of «04118»; properly, a hurry; hence (adverbially) promptly:--hastily, quickly, shortly, soon, make (with) speed(-ily), swiftly.

H4122.def: from «04118» and «07998» and «02363» and «0957»; hasting (is he (the enemy) to the) booty, swift (to the) prey; Maher-Shalal-Chash-Baz; the symbolical name of the son of Isaiah:--Maher-sha-lal-bash-baz.

H4124.et: from a prolonged form of the prepositional prefix m- and (01)
H4124.def: from a prolonged form of the prepositional prefix m- and «01»; from (her (the mother's)) father; Moab, an incestuous son of Lot; also his territory and descendants:--Moab.

H4125.def: feminine Mownabiyah {mo-aw-bee-yaw'}; or Mowabiyth {mo-aw-beeth'}; patronymical from «04124»; a Moabite or Moabitess, i.e. a descendant from Moab:--(woman) of Moab, Moabite(-ish, -ss).

H4127.def: a primitive root; to melt, i.e. literally (to soften, flow down, disappear), or figuratively (to fear, faint):--consume, dissolve, (be) faint(-hearted), melt (away), make soft.

H4129.def: or rather modao {mo-daw'}; from «03045»; an acquaintance:--kinswoman.

H4131.def: a primitive root; to waver; by implication , to slip, shake, fall:--be carried, cast, be out of course, be fallen in decay, × exceedingly, fall(-ing down), be (re-)moved, be ready, shake, slide, slip.

H4132.def: from «04131»; a wavering, i.e. fall; by implication, a pole (as shaking); hence, a yoke (as essentially a bent pole):--bar, be moved, staff, yoke.

H4133.def: feminine of «04132»; a pole; by implication, an ox-bow; hence, a yoke (either literal or figurative):--bands, heavy, staves, yoke.

H4134.def: a primitive root; to become thin, i.e. (figuratively) be impoverished:--be (waxen) poor(-er).

H4135.def: a primitive root; to cut short, i.e. curtail (specifically the prepuce, i.e. to circumcise); by implication, to blunt; figuratively, to destroy:--circumcise(-ing), selves), cut down (in pieces), destroy, × must needs.

H4136.def: or mowl (Deuteronomy 1:1) {mole}; or mowtl (Nehemiah 12:38) {mole}; or mul (Numbers 22:5) {mool}; from «04135»; properly, abrupt, i.e. a precipice; by implication, the front; used only adverbially (with prepositional prefix) opposite:--(over) against, before, (fore-)front, from, (God-)ward, toward, with.

H4137.def: from «03205»; birth; Moladah, a place in Palestine:--Moladah.

H4138.def: from «03205»; nativity (plural birth-place); by implication, lineage, native country; also offspring, family:--begotten, born, issue, kindred, native(-ity).

H4141.def: from «05437»; a turn, i.e. circuit (of a building):--winding about.

H4142.def: or mucabbah {moo-sab-baw'}; feminine of «04141»; a reversal, i.e. the backside (of a gem), fold (of a double-leaved door), transmutation (of a name):--being changed, inclosed, be set, turning.

H4145.def: feminine of «04143»; a foundation; figuratively, an appointment:--foundation, grounded. Compare «04328».

H4146.def: or mocadah {mo-saw-daw'}; feminine of «04144»; a foundation:--foundation.

H4147.def: also (in plural) feminine mowcerah {mo-say-raw'}; or mocrah {mo-ser-aw'}; from «03256»; properly, chastisement, i.e. (by implication) a halter; figuratively, restraint:--band, bond.

H4148.def: from «03256»; properly, chastisement; figuratively, reproof, warning or instruction; also restraint:--bond, chastening ((-eth)), chastisement, check, correction, discipline, doctrine, instruction, rebuke.

H4149.def: or (plural) Mocrowth {mo-ser-othe'} feminine of «04147»; correction or corrections; Moserah or Moseroth, a place in the Desert:--Mosera, Moseroth.

H4150.def: or moled {mo-ade'}; or (feminine) moweadah (2 Chronicles 8:13) {mo-aw-daw'}; from «03259»; properly, an appointment, i.e. a fixed time or season; specifically, a festival; conventionally a year; by implication, an assembly (as convened for a definite purpose); technically the congregation; by extension, the place of meeting; also a signal (as appointed beforehand):--appointed (sign, time), (place of, solemn) assembly, congregation, (set, solemn) feast, (appointed, due) season, solemn(-ity), synogogue, (set) time (appointed).

H4151.def: from «03259»; properly, an assembly (as in «04150»); figuratively, a troop:--appointed time.

H4152.def: from «03259»; an appointed place, i.e. asylum:--appointed.

H4153.def: from «04151» and «03050»; assembly of Jah; Moadjah, an Israelite:--Moadiah. Compare «04573».

H4154.def: feminine passive participle of «04571»; properly, made to slip, i.e. dislocated:--out of joint.

H4155.def: from «05774»; properly, covered, i.e. dark; abstractly, obscurity, i.e. distress:--dimness.

H4158.def: (Jer. 48:21 or meyphaath {may-fah'-ath}; or mephaath {may-fah'-ath; from «03313»; illuminative; Mophaath or Mephaath, a place in Palestine:--Mephaath.

H4159.et: from (03302) in the sense of conspicuousness
H4159.def: or mopheth {mo-faith'}; from «03302» in the sense of conspicuousness; a miracle; by implication, a token or omen:--miracle, sign, wonder(-ed at).

H4160.def: a primitive root; to press, i.e. (figuratively) to oppress:--extortioner.

H4161.def: or motsai {mo-tsaw'}; from «03318»; a going forth, i.e. (the act) an egress, or (the place) an exit; hence, a source or product; specifically, dawn, the rising of the sun (the East), exportation, utterance, a gate, a fountain, a mine, a meadow (as producing grass):--brought out, bud, that which came out, east, going forth, goings out, that which (thing that) is gone out, outgoing, proceeded out, spring, vein, (water-)course (springs).

H4162.def: the same as «04161»; Motsa, the name of two Israelites:--Moza.

H4163.def: feminine of «04161»; a family descent; also a sewer (marg.; compare «06675»):--draught house; going forth.

H4164.def: or muwtsaq {moo-tsawk'}; from «03332»; narrowness; figuratively, distress:--anguish, is straitened, straitness.

H4165.def: from «05694»; properly, fusion, i.e. literally, a casting (of metal); figuratively, a mass (of clay):--casting, hardness.

H4166.def: or mutsaqah {moo-tsaw-kaw'}; from «03332»; properly, something poured out, i.e. a casting (of metal); by implication, a tube (as cast):--when it was cast, pipe.

H4167.def: a primitive root; to jeer, i.e. (intens.) blaspheme:--be corrupt.

H4168.def: from «03344»; a fire or fuel; abstractly, a conflagration:--burning, hearth.

H4170.def: or moqesh {mo-kashe'}; from «03369»; a noose (for catching animals) (literally or figuratively): by implication, a hook (for the nose):--be ensnared, gin, (is) snare(-d), trap.

H4171.def: a primitive root; to alter; by implication, to barter, to dispose of:--X at all, (ex-)change, remove.

H4172.def: or morat {mo-raw'}; or morah (Psa. 9:20) {mo-raw'}; from «03372»; fear; by implication, a fearful thing or deed:--dread, (that ought to be) fear(-ed), terribleness, terror.

H4173.et: from an unused root meaning to triturate
H4173.def: or morag {mo-rag'}; from an unused root meaning to triturate; a threshing sledge:--threshing instrument.

H4174.def: from «03381»; a descent; as architecture, an ornamental appendage, perhaps a festoon:--going down, steep place, thin work.

H4175.def: from «03384»; an archer; also teacher or teaching; also the early rain (see «03138»):--(early) rain.

H4176.def: or Moreh {mo-reh'}; the same as «04175»; Moreh, a Canaanite; also a hill (perhaps named from him):--Moreh.

H4177.et: from (04171) in the sense of shearing
H4177.def: from «04171» in the sense of shearing; a razor:--razor.

H4179.def: or Moriyah {mo-ree-yaw'}; from «07200» and «03050»; seen of Jah; Morijah, a hill in Palestine:--Moriah.

H4180.def: from «03423»; a possession; figuratively, delight:-- possession, thought.

H4181.def: feminine of «04180»; a possession:--heritage, inheritance, possession.

H4182.def: from «03423» and «01661»; possession of Gath; Moresheth-Gath, a place in Palestine:--Moresheth-gath.

H4183.def: patrial from «04182»; a Morashtite or inhabitant of Moresheth-Gath:--Morashthite.

H4184.def: a primitive root; to touch:--feel, handle.

H4185.et: a primitive root [perhaps rather the same as (04184) through the idea of receding by contact]
H4185.def: a primitive root (perhaps rather the same as «04184» through the idea of receding by contact); to withdraw (both literally and figuratively, whether intransitive or transitive):--cease, depart, go back, remove, take away.

H4186.def: or moshab {mo-shawb'}; from «03427»; a seat; figuratively, a site; abstractly, a session; by extension an abode (the place or the time); by implication, population:--assembly, dwell in, dwelling(-place), wherein (that) dwelt (in), inhabited place, seat, sitting, situation, sojourning.

H4187.def: or Mushshiy {mush-shee'}; from «04184»; sensitive; Mushi, a Levite:--Mushi.

H4188.def: patronymical from «04187»; a Mushite (collectively) or descendants of Mushi:--Mushites.

H4189.def: act participle feminine of «04900»; something drawing, i.e. (figuratively) a cord:--band.

H4191.def: a primitive root: to die (literally or figuratively); causatively, to kill:--X at all, × crying, (be) dead (body, man, one), (put to, worthy of) death, destroy(-er), (cause to, be like to, must) die, kill, necro(-mancer), × must needs, slay, × surely, × very suddenly, × in (no) wise.

H4192.et: from (04191) and (01121) with the preposition and article interposed
H4192.def: (Psalm «048» or Muwth lab-ben {mooth lab-bane'}; from «04191» and «01121» with the preposition and article interposed; "To die for the son", probably the title of a popular song:--death, Muthlabben.

H4194.def: from «04191»; death (natural or violent); concretely, the dead, their place or state (hades); figuratively, pestilence, ruin:--(be) dead((-ly)), death, die(-d).

H4195.def: from «03498»; literally, gain; figuratively, superiority:--plenteousness, preeminence, profit.

H4197.et: from an unused root meaning to mingle (water with wine)
H4197.def: from an unused root meaning to mingle (water with wine); tempered wine:--liquor.

H4198.et: from an unused root meaning to suck out
H4198.def: from an unused root meaning to suck out; exhausted:--burnt.

H4199.et: probably from an unused root meaning to faint with fear
H4199.def: probably from an unused root meaning to faint with fear; terror; Mizzah, an Edomite:--Mizzah.
